data.notes: February 2027 has no confirmed Top of the Mountain concert yet, but the Paznaun valley calendar does confirm several DJ-led and music-accompanied winter events around Ischgl.

events.title: Kronehit BergBeat Tour with DJ Instyle
events.venueName: Roof terrace at Sunny Mountain, Kappl ski resort
events.summary: KRONEHIT brings its BergBeat Tour to the Sunny Mountain terrace in nearby Kappl for a daytime winter rave in the snow. DJ Instyle is confirmed to play from 13:00 to 17:00 on Sunday, 28 February 2027.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever
events.summary: Recurring Wednesday night event at Medrigalm in See, with its own stage, music-led performances and a laser show alongside night skiing and tobogganing. The official calendar lists February dates on 3, 10, 17 and 24 February 2027; this entry uses 3 February as a representative confirmed date.

events.title: Niki's Stadl Daily DJ Après-Ski Residency
events.summary: Long-running Ischgl après-ski institution operating daily in the 2026/27 winter season, with DJs driving a daily party-hits format from 15:00 to midnight.

events.title: Nightshow Ischgl
events.summary: Ischgl’s winter Nightshow combines ski-school demo performances, snow-sport stunts and DJ accompaniment at Prennerhang by the Pardatschgratbahn valley station. The official calendar lists February performances on 9 and 23 February 2027; this entry uses 9 February as a representative confirmed date.
